title: AR21002: Behavioural Studies In Architecture
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Man- Environment relationship; Positive and normative theories. Behavioural
Science and modern movement, Substantive theory on Environment and human
behaviour, SocialStimulation and interaction, the Affordances of the built
environment, Gestalt theory of Perception- Cognition and Affect, Spatial
behavior, Environmental Determinism, Environmental possibilism and
Environmental probabilism, Concept of Fit â Adaptibility and flexibility,
Anthropometrics and Ergonomics, Barrier free environmental design,
Territoriality, Defensible space, Social space â the Westgate theory,
Behavioural concepts in Neighbourhood and Urban Design, Speculative aesthetics
and symbolic aesthetics, Semantic and Semiotic approaches, Contemporary Sociophysical issues in environmental design.
